name: jsonx-generative-ui
purpose: Decide when UI is warranted, then generate a safe JSONX/JXM payload or IDE handoff file.
example: Use jsonx-generative-ui to ask whether a study user wants a quiz UI, then write .jsonx/ui/practice-quiz.json.

name: jsonx-component-registry
purpose: Design or audit the allowed component registry for generated UI.
example: Use jsonx-component-registry to review whether MetricRow props are safe.

name: jsonx-demo-builder
purpose: Build a local prompt-to-JSONX demo using the repo site conventions.
example: Use jsonx-demo-builder to add a fixture prompt and rendered demo panel.

name: jsonx-safety-review
purpose: Review JSONX payload validation, blocked props, and action mapping.
example: Use jsonx-safety-review to check a public demo for dangerous JSONX features.
